args.question: I have found that Real-Time Session Efficiency (RTSE) is defined as the ratio of Content Interaction Efficiency (CIE) to the Session Bounce Rate Adjustment (SBRA). I have also found the definition of Session Bounce Rate Adjustment (SBRA) in terms of the columns 'bncrate' and 'ctrval', but I could not find a definition of Content Interaction Efficiency (CIE). Can you provide a definition of CIE?

tool_trajectory.result: Content Interaction Efficiency (CIE) is approximated by averaging the sequence value from interactions for each session.

args.sql:
WITH SessionMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        i.seshlink2 AS session_id,
        AVG(i.seqval) AS avg_seq_value
    FROM 
        interactions i
    GROUP BY 
        i.seshlink2
),
BounceAdjustments AS (
    SELECT 
        s.seshkey AS session_id,
        s.bncrate * (1 - s.ctrval / 100.0) AS bounce_adjustment
    FROM 
        sessions s
),
SessionEfficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.session_id,
        ba.bounce_adjustment,
        sm.avg_seq_value AS avg_seq_value,
        CASE 
            WHEN ba.bounce_adjustment = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE sm.avg_seq_value / ba.bounce_adjustment 
        END AS efficiency_score
    FROM 
        SessionMetrics sm
    JOIN 
        BounceAdjustments ba ON sm.session_id = ba.session_id
)
SELECT 
    se.session_id,
    s.seshstart AS start_time,
    s.bncrate AS bounce_impact,
    se.avg_seq_value,
    se.efficiency_score
FROM 
    SessionEfficiency se
JOIN 
    sessions s ON se.session_id = s.seshkey
ORDER BY 
    se.session_id;
